content: Installed Reanimated 4.5.1 supports UI-thread shared values, derived values, withTiming, withDecay, cancelAnimation. UI writes synchronous and JS async; avoid JS mirror hit-testing. withDecay default inertia is too broad for constrained camera and must explicitly clamp/reduce velocity. ReducedMotion.System timing can jump immediately; implement app's approved short direct path intentionally using live OS shared hook. Reanimated useReducedMotion is boot-only; existing Orbit AccessibilityInfo controller provides live changes but needs stale initial-seed guard.
